newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chinon Ind subsidiaries cause of loss forecast. [CORRECTED 09:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Chinon Ind subsidiaries cause of loss forecast. [CORRECTED 09:30 GMT]

text.p: Chinon Industries Co Ltd said on Friday that losses racked up by its overseas subsidiaries caused the firm to forecast a net loss of five billion yen in the half-year business period which ended on September 30. (Corrects business period).
The video camera lens manufacturer said in a statement that it had decided to disband its four subsidiaries in the United States, Germany, Singapore and Malaysia on December 31.
The move was the last step in restructuring measures started a few years ago, Chinon said.
It said that a plan to shrink its debts, which ballooned to 6.4 billion yen in the first half of the business year, would be announced at a later date.
The company said it revised its forecast for the year to March 31, 1997, to a net loss of 4.95 billion yen from a previous forecast of a 200 million yen profit.
